name: Morino Yukino
source: [url=/c6967]Yuuma's[/url] childhood friend and a lover of shoujo manga. She has unique gentle qualities, and makes the people around her feel warm. Because she is such a cute and gentle girl, her popularity with the boys is very high. The rumors of them dating is pretty widespread. Although she cannot confirm her feelings clearly, when her relationship with the protagonist as lovers is denied, even if its true, she feels very sad. In short, she is in a delicate state.
